name: io.github.tonyyang0504/flipkart-mcp
description: Flipkart (ecommerce channels): me, list_orders. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_FLIPKART_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Seller API access token of your Self Access Application (Seller Dashboard > Manage Profile > Developer Access): obtain it with GET https://api.flipkart.net/oauth-service/oauth/token?grant_type=client_credentials&scope=Seller_Api,Default using HTTP Basic appId:appSecret. It is valid about 60 days; replace it when calls start failing with 401 (the runtime cannot run Flipkart's GET token call itself).
